research_question: Does a mechanically anchored 08:00 UTC option-settlement liquidity raid, confirmed by BTC/ETH SMT non-confirmation and post-settlement displacement, create repeatable Bybit BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT after-cost reversal alpha with a structural path materially closer to 1% daily geometric NAV growth?

economic_mechanism.institutional_anchor: Deribit final expiry delivery uses a 07:30-08:00 UTC index TWAP and expiring delta decays toward zero into 08:00 UTC.
smc_ict_translation: external liquidity raid during the known settlement window
causal post-08:00 displacement or micro market-structure break
next-open entry in the swept contract
pre-range equilibrium or opposing external liquidity target
economic_mechanism.failure_condition: The mechanism is rejected if fit cannot pass concentration and temporal-breadth gates, or if the exact frozen rule fails 2023 development at 18/24 bp and materially exceeds neither the current first-place growth rate nor the precommitted 0.10% daily gate.

sources.role: Defines 08:00 UTC settlement, the 07:30-08:00 final-delivery TWAP, and expiry delta decay.
Motivates the falsifiable reversal hypothesis around Bitcoin option expiry; it is not used as performance evidence for this strategy.

data_contract.fallback_source: Official Binance Vision USD-M 5-minute candles, diagnostic and non-rank-eligible only
data_contract.funding: Actual Bybit historical funding when available; otherwise conservative 1 bp charge at every crossed 8-hour boundary and non-rank-eligible status.
data_contract.current_product_limit: Current Bybit instrument max leverage is fetched and applied as a product bound; unavailable metadata falls back to a non-rank-eligible 100x diagnostic ceiling.

information_timing.settlement_window: 07:30-07:55 UTC completed 5-minute bars representing the official 07:30-08:00 interval
information_timing.entry: Open of the next 5-minute bar after all confirmation bars have completed

execution_contract.exit_model: structural stop or structural target only; no elapsed-time liquidation
execution_contract.favorable_target_gap: fill at target, no favorable price improvement
execution_contract.terminal_open_position: mark at final available close and flag terminal exit
execution_contract.risk_sizing: NAV risk budget divided by stop distance plus all-in cost plus 2 bp funding-loss buffer

fit_requirements_at_18bp: positive return after removing the top 10% winning trades
selection_and_gates.selection: Among fit-gate passers, lexicographically maximize full-calendar geometric daily growth, then minimize MDD, then maximize trades, then policy id. If no fit policy passes, 2023 remains unopened.
development_requirements: positive H1 and H2 at 18 bp
positive return after top-10%-winner removal at 18 and 24 bp
18 bp geometric daily growth at 1% risk >= 0.10%
18 bp geometric daily growth exceeds current first-place 0.0573077%
zero terminal exits and no bankruptcy
selection_and_gates.risk_ladder_role: Feasibility diagnostic only; it cannot rescue a non-positive base edge.

ranking.reason: Pre-2024 fatal screen; exact BBO/depth execution and official 2024-2026 causal evaluation remain closed.

non_overlap: Bybit funding transfer and premium-anchor rules
